falseSynonyms.zh: 擅長不等於有益 be good at 表示某人擅長某事；be good for 表示某事對某人／某物有益。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is good at maths; exercise is good for her health.

falseSynonyms.zh: 善待不等於有益 be good to someone 通常表示善待某人；be good for someone 表示對某人有益。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He is good to his staff; regular rest is good for staff wellbeing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 享受不等於受益 enjoy 表示喜歡或享受某事；喜歡某事不代表它一定有益。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON People may enjoy something that is not especially good for them.

falseSynonyms.zh: 喜歡不等於有益 like 表示偏好；be good for 描述正面效果。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can like a food even if it is not good for your health.

falseSynonyms.zh: 需要不等於有益 need 表示必需；某事有益不代表它是必需品。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Something can be beneficial without being necessary.

falseSynonyms.zh: 適合不等於有益 suitable 表示匹配用途或情況；good for 強調正面效果。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A tool may be suitable for a task without providing a wider benefit.

falseSynonyms.zh: 保護不等於一般有益 protect 是防止傷害；它可以是一種益處，但語義比 be good for 更具體。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Sunscreen protects the skin; that protection is one reason it is good for skin health.

falseSynonyms.zh: 治癒不等於有益 cure 表示消除疾病；be good for health 只表示有益，不能推出治療效果。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A healthy habit may benefit health without curing a disease.
